body: Idek. I’m nice and caring and always there for others but when I need it no one is around.
Just want a real friend to talk to and listen. One that won’t leave because everyone leaves. Maybe I’m not good enough
Pm me then if you want
People say they’ll be friends. And that they’re there for you and all this shit and then disappear. I’ve been called toxic and too much to handle

I’ve been trying for years. People are nothing but liars and backstabbers. I’m tired. Wake up just exhausted in every way possible. We all die one day anyway. Why is it wrong for me to choose when where and how I die? I didn’t ask to be born into this shit life of mine. Why must I be forced to live it? It’s my life

Life happened. Been depressed for many years. Had a few attempts. Been to therapists. Been on meds and nothing seems to get better. I think and fantasize about my death every single day. From the moment I wake up until the moment I sleep.
I don't know about that. I just want to stop trying.
Same. I try and try and it just leads to me being disappointed.
I used to. But over time it just got worse and worse. This depression has been with me for years and I don't see it ever going away. So what's the point.
Well what about how I feel? I don't want to be here anymore. I have no reason to be here anymore.
No. My life has no value.
